inspection.automatic_flag_disposition: All 32 sparse-page candidates are intentional part leaves, transition notes, short exercise endings, or appendix openings. None is an empty-output, clipping, overflow, or missing-content defect.

repaired_page_review.observation: The repaired representability passage remains inside the text block. RTL prose, quantified formulas, overlines, subscripts, punctuation and page furniture are complete and legible; no edge clipping or collision is visible.

method: Every physical page was inspected on no-resize 4x4 contact sheets generated from the exact PDF at 96 dpi. Every automatically flagged page and the repaired physical page 729 were then inspected as individual original-detail PNGs.
limitations: Visual acceptance proves rendered layout integrity, not independent semantic equivalence of every translated sentence.
Publication identity and public accessibility remain separate gates.
